additions.reason: The Rebbe states explicitly that the act of surrendering one's שֵׁם (reputation) 'הוּא בְּחִינַת מְסִירַת נֶפֶשׁ מַמָּשׁ' — it IS, in its essential nature, actual self-sacrifice. This is bechina language (not eitza): the voluntary loss of one's שֵׁם is not merely the cause of מְסִירַת נֶפֶשׁ — it IS מְסִירַת נֶפֶשׁ, because שֵׁם = נֶפֶשׁ. מְסִירַת נֶפֶשׁ belongs to the same bechina cluster as שֵׁם and נֶפֶשׁ — it is the name for the act that expresses their shared identity.
additions.source_quote: וְעוֹשֶׂה זֶה בְּכַוָּנָה, כִּי הוּא בְּחִינַת מְסִירַת נֶפֶשׁ מַמָּשׁ, כִּי הַשֵּׁם הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ כַּנַּ"ל

notes: All three dataset nodes (שם, נפש, מפרסם) are fully assigned to Package 1. There are no orphaned nodes.

The Torah source text (line 1) opens with the primary bechina equation 'הַשֵּׁם הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ' and cites Torah #59 (הֵיכַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ) for the full derivation. The bechina שם=נפש is captured in edge 2151.

Line 3 uses 'בִּבְחִינַת: הָעֲמֻסִּים מִנִּי בֶטֶן' to describe Israel as 'portions of the Shechina,' but this is a scriptural prooftext in an eitza context (souls ascending to the Shechina produces the divine union) — not a standalone bechina equation between two conceptual nodes in this Torah.

Lines 5–6 introduce the phenomenon of אֲבֵדַת הַשֵּׁם (loss of the Name) as the inverse of the positive מְסִירַת שֵׁם — both are grounded in the same שם=נפש=מפרסם identity. No additional bechina nodes are introduced.
The teaching references Torah #59 (הֵיכַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ, LM1:59) for the underlying metaphysics. The nodes in that Torah that established שם=נפש are not re-derived here; Torah #260 presupposes them.
